column1: # R38MapRetro: case id -> instruction.md lines the case's state violates.
# Round-37 receipt CASE lines predate the `violates=` tag (they carry `-- <requirement>` prose), so the
# violates-set for round-38 C2 V7's derived-label rule is recorded here, one row per frozen case, in the
# Field 1: case id. Field 2: comma-separated instruction.md lines ("-" = violates no mapped line: control).
# Field 3: justification, grounded in the case's own `-- requirement` text and the instruction line's words.
# Scope rule: a case's violates-set holds the instruction lines whose requirement the case's constructed
# state does not meet; lines the case neither exercises nor contradicts stay out of it.
